result.instructions: Lambo agentic graph memory for session 'smoke-1'. Call lambo_recall before acting on a task to load relevant prior memory, lambo_derive and lambo_record_action to write what you learned and did, lambo_reserve before editing a shared concept, and lambo_inspect / lambo_saints / lambo_stats to look around. Every tool takes your agent_id. Never send a timestamp: the server stamps them.

tools.name: lambo_derive
tools.description: Derive concepts from the current interaction into session memory. Timestamps are stamped server-side; do not send one.

WireConceptType.description:
Concept type as it crosses the wire. Mirrors [`ConceptType`] rather than
deriving `JsonSchema` on the core type, so the MCP schema is owned here and
a core rename cannot silently change a published tool schema.

concepts.description: Concepts to derive from this interaction.

parent_of.description:
Optional `(parent, child)` hierarchy pairs. Both ends resolve (and may
be created) as concepts.

tools.name: lambo_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the neighbourhood around a concept: its type, canonization status, blast radius and typed edges out to a depth.

depth.description: Hops out from the focus (default 2, max 5).

focus.description: Concept content (or a node UUID) to centre the neighbourhood on.

tools.name: lambo_recall
tools.description: Recall relevant memory for a query and return the Lambo context block (canonical markers, blast-radius warnings, conflict lines).

agent_id.description: Calling agent (spec §2.2 — see the attribution note in the tool docs).

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the rendered context block.

top_k.description: Hits to return. Defaults to the session config's `default_top_k`.

traversal_depth.description: Graph traversal depth for phase 2 expansion.

tools.name: lambo_record_action
tools.description: Record an action the agent took, with what it produces, modifies and depends on. Timestamps are stamped server-side; do not send one.

action.description: The action taken — becomes a `Resource` concept.

depends_on.description: Things this action depends on (`Dependency` edges).

tools.name: lambo_reserve
tools.description: Take a soft lock on a memory node before editing it (or release one). Reservations are advisory and do not survive a server restart.

node_id.description:
Node to reserve, as a UUID string (from `lambo_recall` or
`lambo_inspect`).

release.description: Release this agent's existing soft lock instead of taking one.

tools.name: lambo_saints
tools.description: List the session's canonical memories — concepts that earned Canonical status through the audited transition path.

tools.name: lambo_stats
tools.description: Session health: flush lag, write-behind log depth, node/edge/concept counts, canonization progress and degraded state.
